params.message:
Research briefs for the Gentells desk, from the voice and from sessions

set_out_research in the voice bridge, studio_research_draft in the systems MCP and
research.mjs on the command line, all through one researchParams so the gateway judges
the same parameters whoever asks. A write (B2, kind studio.research_draft on
observatory:pipeline): the owner's admission for today, the gateway, and the pipeline's
own check; the brief waits in Studio › Write, ready for review.
